name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Partner Integrations & Technical Account Leader
summary: Partner integrations and technical account leader with 15+ years across SaaS, MarTech, and platform-partnership environments, owning integration implementation end to end. Translates technical concepts — API integrations, CRM/CMS connections, and loyalty and marketing-automation platforms — into business solutions for external technology partners, and drives high-visibility launches in close partnership with product and engineering. Detail-oriented program manager and analytical problem-solver who serves as the day-to-day face of the integration to partners while capturing every requirement for both business and technical stakeholders.

Lead end-to-end implementation for new technology stacks — translating business requirements into technical configurations, scoping the integration, and providing hands-on training and launch support.
Decompose manual, multi-system workflows into agent architectures with custom logic, then design self-improving evaluation loops that monitor outputs and continuously optimize performance.
Serve as the primary strategic and day-to-day contact for a portfolio of B2B clients, leading discovery to understand goals, objectives, and market challenges before scoping a solution.
Partner directly with business owners and cross-functional teams to align integrations and programs with revenue objectives, ensuring consistent execution and qualified outcomes.
Build performance dashboards and analyze complex operational datasets, synthesizing results into structured insights and recommendations that drive prioritization.

Collaborated with Product and Engineering to translate structured, high-priority partner feedback into roadmap inputs and process improvements.

Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to surface adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
